newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mexico cuts Dec Maya price to Asia, raises Isthmus.
newsitem.headline: Mexico cuts Dec Maya price to Asia, raises Isthmus.

text.p: Mexico has lowered the price formula for its December-lifting Maya crude oil to Asia by 20 cents per barrel but raised the price of Isthmus crude by 15 cents, traders said on Friday.
December Maya was lowered by 20 cents from the November price to the average of Oman and Dubai quotations minus $2.90 per barrel, traders said.
December-lifting Isthmus was raised by 15 cents from the previous month to the average of Oman and Dubai quotations plus 75 cents, they said.
